question: When a team led by 10 or more points at the end of the 3rd quarter, how often did it win? Use all games from 2015-16 to 2022-23 (regular season and playoffs).
answer:
NBA teams leading by 10 or more points at the end of the third quarter won 95.2% of their games (4,172 of 4,381 games) between the 2015-16 and 2022-23 seasons. Only two teams in this eight-season span successfully came back to win after trailing by 20 or more points entering the fourth quarter.

| Lead Size after Q3 | Games (n) | Wins | Win % |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 10–14 points | 1,781 | 1,612 | 90.5% |
| 15–19 points | 1,210 | 1,172 | 96.9% |
| 20+ points | 1,390 | 1,388 | 99.9% |
| **Total (10+ Lead)** | **4,381** | **4,172** | **95.2%** |

* **Historically rare comebacks**: Out of 1,390 games where a team trailed by 20+ points after three quarters, only two teams came back to win: Toronto overcame a 23-point deficit against Dallas on Dec 22, 2019 (110-107), and Atlanta overcame a 26-point deficit against Cleveland on Apr 9, 2017 (126-125 in OT).
* **Data coverage**: This analysis includes 9,276 regular season and playoff games with play-by-play data from October 2015 to June 2023.
* **Tracking limitations**: The dataset contains event scoring margins but has no tracking data, shot-clock values, or lineup information to explain how these comebacks occurred.

args.query:
WITH q3 AS (
  SELECT game_id, home_margin AS m3 
  FROM plays 
  WHERE event_type = 'PERIOD_END' AND period = 3
),
lead AS (
  SELECT q.game_id, ABS(m3) AS lead_pts, (m3 > 0) = g.home_won AS held
  FROM q3 q 
  JOIN games g USING (game_id) 
  WHERE ABS(m3) >= 10
)
SELECT 
  'Overall (10+)' AS lead_group,
  COUNT(*) AS games, 
  SUM(held::INT) AS wins, 
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(held::INT), 1) AS win_pct
FROM lead
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN lead_pts >= 20 THEN '20+ points' 
    WHEN lead_pts >= 15 THEN '15-19 points' 
    ELSE '10-14 points' 
  END AS lead_group,
  COUNT(*) AS games, 
  SUM(held::INT) AS wins, 
  ROUND(100.0 * AVG(held::INT), 1) AS win_pct
FROM lead
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY win_pct ASC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) AS total_pbp_games FROM plays
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT game_id) FROM plays WHERE event_type = 'PERIOD_END' AND period = 3

WITH q3 AS (
  SELECT game_id, home_margin AS m3 
  FROM plays 
  WHERE event_type = 'PERIOD_END' AND period = 3
),
lead AS (
  SELECT q.game_id, ABS(m3) AS lead_pts, m3, (m3 > 0) AS home_led, g.home_won,
         g.home_team, g.away_team, g.game_date, g.pts_home, g.pts_away, g.winner
  FROM q3 q 
  JOIN games g USING (game_id) 
  WHERE ABS(m3) >= 20
)
SELECT game_date, home_team, away_team, m3 AS q3_margin, pts_home, pts_away, winner
FROM lead
WHERE (m3 > 0 AND NOT home_won) OR (m3 < 0 AND home_won)
